snippet.title: Hive Blight - Trailer
snippet.description:
Hive Blight is a roguelite autobattler game that revolves around creating synergies. Set in a miniature world plagued by an ancient evil, you're in charge of a team of insect warriors with a singular purpose: to defeat the Fungal Threat. Find its source and eliminate it once and for all!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2886620/Hive_Blight/
